messages:
noah_sales: Heads up 52 Concord (enterprise) wants a short validation session: Okta SSO (SP-initiated), SCIM group sync, and confirmation on domain ownership flows + Dedicated pricing info. They're asking for a 45m slot next Wed morning.

maya_se: Happy to run it. Two quick clarifiers: 1) Are they planning to JIT-provision users or rely solely on SCIM? 2) Expected scale for the test org (users and groups)?

concord_okta_admin: We'll use SCIM as primary provisioning, JIT not required. Test org: ~1.5k users, ~600 groups. We need SCIM delta under 2 minutes for role assignment flows.

oliver_sec: Security front: Hosted has TLS + AES-256 at rest; BYOK via KMS is possible but requires vendor questionnaire + key handling approval. Dedicated supports customer-managed HSM. Also need to know retention windows and whether PII/lists will be provisioned via SCIM.

fiona_prod: Product notes: SCIM supports incremental sync with cursor paging, suitable for 600+ groups. Default Hosted SCIM throttle is 5rps (can be raised on Dedicated). Group->role mapping is supported; we also have precedence rules (explicit mapping > inherited). Domain verification: DNS TXT or email token. For cert rotation we support manual and automated upload flows.

maya_se: POC plan (compact):
- Exchange SP metadata & ACS URL
- Provide scoped SCIM token and test endpoint
- Apply group->role mapping file and run a sample full sync (200 users)
- Run deltas and a cert rotation test
- Verify audit logs & SCIM latency under load
I'll post a runbook and a small SCIM test harness.

ruth_legal: Legal: request their legal contact and whether they need EU data residency. I'll prep DPA + SOC2 Type II and confirm deletion SLA. If Dedicated in EU required, contracts will reflect that region.

noah_sales: Pricing Q from Concord: "If we move to Dedicated (EU) for compliance, what's the rough monthly difference for ~100M tokens?" Any rough ballpark to share?

fiona_prod: Quick ballpark: Hosted consumption at ~$0.0008/token -> ~ $80k/month for 100M. Dedicated adds infra/ops premium and commit; ballpark delta +$20k-45k/month depending on replication/DR and GPU footprint. Finance needs to firm it up. For POC we can reserve a short Dedicated slot (7-14 days) if needed.

oliver_sec: Operational note: because they expect ~600 groups, enable cursor paging and recommend batching updates. Confirm Okta's rate limits and token rotation policy; if their rotation is frequent (<30d) we should discuss automated rekeying.

maya_se: I'll include rollback steps (fallback to Hosted behavior) and a checklist for cert rotation and audit validation. Action items: Maya to draft runbook; Oliver to send vendor questionnaire + BYOK checklist; Ruth to prepare DPA + SOC2; Noah to get Concord legal contact and confirm Wed slot.

scheduler-bot: Scheduling reminder: maintenance window Wed 08:15-08:45 PT 52 no expected customer impact.

concord_okta_admin: Wed works for us, 09:30 PT preferred. I'll DM SP metadata and a test admin account.

noah_sales: Great 52 locking 09:30 Wed. Maya 52 please send invite + runbook. Oliver/Ruth 52 please send docs before EOD Tue. Thanks! :rocket:
